independent_computation.question: Should the damage event at fights/manual_target/damage_events[6] of the Syndra 120-splinter custom-cast-order fight be sourced Q (Dark Sphere) or R (Unleashed Power)?
independent_computation.step_1_what_R_prices: S1 says R conjures 3 spheres and grabs up to 4 live ones, then barrages the target with ALL collected spheres, 'each dealing magic damage upon hit'. So R's damage instance count ranges 3..7.

step_2_arithmetic_proof_the_grabbed_sphe.check: Minimum Magic Damage should equal 3 x Magic Damage per Sphere; Maximum should equal 7 x Magic Damage per Sphere, if and only if every barraged sphere (conjured AND grabbed) is priced at R's per-sphere rate.
step_2_arithmetic_proof_the_grabbed_sphe.rank_1: 3 x 80 = 240 = listed Minimum 240; 3 x 20% AP = 60% AP = listed 60% AP. 7 x 80 = 560 = listed Maximum 560; 7 x 20% = 140% AP = listed 140% AP.
step_2_arithmetic_proof_the_grabbed_sphe.conclusion: All six identities hold exactly, flat and AP-ratio. The up-to-4 GRABBED spheres - which are Dark Spheres created by Q casts - are priced by R's 'Magic Damage per Sphere' row, not by Q's row. A Q-created sphere thrown by R therefore deals R damage, not Q damage.

independent_computation.step_3_contrast_with_Q_row: Q's own row (S3) is 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) and pays out once, on the conjuring hit, at the sphere's spawn. It is numerically incompatible with R's per-sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP). Labelling a barrage instance 'Q' would attach Q's name to a number Q's row never produces, and would break the min/max identities in step 2.
independent_computation.step_4_kit_internal_precedent: S4 states an E-pushed Dark Sphere deals 'Scatter the Weak's damage' - E's number, not Q's - even though Q created the sphere. Riot's own rule for Syndra is that a propelled sphere's damage belongs to the ability that propelled it, never to the ability that spawned it. R is the same case.
independent_computation.step_5_is_there_any_mechanic_that_makes_: R's only other Q-touching effect is its passive (S5): 10/20/30 ability haste on Dark Sphere, reducing Q's 7 s cooldown (Q is flagged affectedByCdr=false, so R's passive is the only haste it gets; at R3, 7 x 100/130 = 5.385 s). That changes Q's CADENCE, never its damage source. No effect anywhere in the kit converts a Dark Sphere conjuring hit into R damage. So there is no correct model in which an event that truly is a Q cast carries source 'R'.
independent_computation.step_6_event_layout_at_120_splinters: At splinters=120 the module exposes (S6/S7) Q, Q2 (2nd charge, unlocked at 40), W magic + W bonus true (unlocked at 60), E, and R x r_spheres, with P applying a global 1.15x AP multiplier (attribution-neutral). Per S8 the damage_events order follows the fight's cast_order; per S9 R is single-cast, so R contributes one contiguous run of sphere instances. Index 6 falls inside that run for every cast order in which R is not scheduled ahead of the Q/W/E block - i.e. the whole Q,Q2,W(2 parts),E prefix is 5 events (indices 0-4), and R's spheres begin at index 5 and run to 5+r_spheres-1 (>= index 7 for r_spheres >= 3). Under the setup/consume edge the rotation resolver is built to detect (F3: an ability that APPLIES precedes the ability that CONSUMES), Q must precede R precisely because R consumes live Dark Spheres, so R-last is the derived and the sourced-optimal placement.
independent_computation.conclusion: Index 6 is a sphere of the Unleashed Power barrage. Its correct source is R. 'Q' is the mis-attribution of a barrage sphere to the ability that spawned the sphere, which S1, S2 (the exact 3x/7x identities) and S4 (the E precedent) all contradict.

residual_uncertainty.note: The scenario definition for 'syndra_custom_order_120' lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/ and tests/ were not read), so the exact custom cast_order and r_spheres value could not be re-derived, only the event layout it must produce.
residual_uncertainty.why_it_does_not_change_the_verdict: Both mechanisms that can place R at index 6 - (a) relabelling barrage spheres from their spawning ability Q to the barraging ability R, and (b) a larger sphere run covering index 6 - land on R being the sourced-correct label for a barrage instance. The only way 'Q' could be right at index 6 is if the event there is a genuine Dark Sphere conjuring hit that the new code renames to R; step 5 shows no mechanic in Syndra's kit does that, so that failure mode is not available.
residual_uncertainty.confidence: high on the attribution rule (arithmetically proven from the cached leveling rows); medium on the index arithmetic (cast_order not visible from data/).
